handoff.salientSummary: Implemented GET /api/v1/evaluations/:id/results endpoint that returns evaluation results (accuracy, metrics, predictions) with pagination support. Returns 409 for pending/running tasks and 404 for not found. Tests pass (6 new tests), manual curl verification confirms correct behavior.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Implemented GET /api/v1/evaluations/:id/results endpoint in internal/handler/evaluation_handler.go. Added GetResults handler that: (1) validates UUID format, (2) checks evaluation exists (404 if not), (3) returns 409 if task is pending/running, (4) retrieves results and predictions with pagination support. Added result repository and prediction repository to EvaluationHandler struct. Added route in cmd/api/main.go. Added 6 unit tests covering all validation assertions.
